title: Endpoint Management Engineer
full_description:
Amsterdam, Netherlands
€5.485,70 - €8.828,03
Are you ready to shape the future of Endpoint Management technology?We are looking for an Endpoint Management Engineer to join our team in Amsterdam and contribute to the design, development and improvement of endpoint management services.
As Endpoint Management Engineer, you will contribute to the strategic product vision and backlog for endpoint management across our global organization. You’ll work at the intersection of Windows, Windows 365 and cloud-native technologies, ensuring seamless, secure, and scalable device experiences for our workforce.
The Computing & Device Services (CDS) squad within People and Hubs/Workplace Services is responsible for the product vision and backlog for the ING Cloud Managed Workplace Services. This comprehends amongst other Windows endpoints, Windows 365 as our Virtual platform and printing services. As Endpoint Management Engineer you will be part of this global squad that is based in The Netherlands, Poland and the Philippines. The Endpoint Management Engineer forms a team with the Product Owner, the IT Chapter Lead, and of course the engineers in the team.
